title: Plant Breeding
modules: 4.0. Inbreeding (F) And Its Consequences Or Applications
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a maternally inherited trait that makes the plant produce sterile pollen."
CMS is a maternally inherited trait that makes the plant produce sterile pollen.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the longest and thinnest during interphase (resting stage) and hence not visible under light microscope."
The chromosomes are the longest and thinnest during interphase (resting stage) and hence not visible under light microscope.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in hybrid seed production."
Cytoplasmic male sterility is used in hybrid seed production.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a classical example of an isochromosome."
The attached 'x' chromosome of Drosophila is a classical example of an isochromosome.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a general name for several genetic mechanisms in angiosperms, which prevent self-fertilization and thus encourage outcrossing."
Self-incompatibility (SI) is a general name for several genetic mechanisms in angiosperms, which prevent self-fertilization and thus encourage outcrossing.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the phenomenon that seeds are produced, but in an essentially asexual way, so that parent and offspring belong to one clonejust as in case of 'normal' asexual propagation."
Apomixis is the phenomenon that seeds are produced, but in an essentially asexual way, so that parent and offspring belong to one clonejust as in case of 'normal' asexual propagation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a big factor, because you have to select when most of the characteristics of the plant are clearly showing."
Time of selection is a big factor, because you have to select when most of the characteristics of the plant are clearly showing.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the opposite of inbreeding depression."
Heterosis is the opposite of inbreeding depression.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a small, extracellular molecule, expressed in the stigma; mthe identity of the male determinant remains elusive, but it is probably some cell membranereceptor."
The female determinant is a small, extracellular molecule, expressed in the stigma; mthe identity of the male determinant remains elusive, but it is probably some cell membranereceptor.
fib: ______ is the art and science of changing the traits of plants in order to produce desired characteristics.
Plant breeding
Plant breeding is the art and science of changing the traits of plants in order to produce desired characteristics.
______ means that farmers are more involved in the breeding process and breeding goals are defined by farmers instead of international seed companies with their large-scale breeding programs.
Participatory
Participatory means that farmers are more involved in the breeding process and breeding goals are defined by farmers instead of international seed companies with their large-scale breeding programs.
______ is a result of the mating of individuals which are related to one another by having one or more common ancestors.
Inbreeding
Inbreeding is a result of the mating of individuals which are related to one another by having one or more common ancestors.
______ is a decline in reproductive performance, ability to survive and other characteristics associated with fitness as a result of inbreeding.
Inbreeding depression
Inbreeding depression Inbreeding depression is a decline in reproductive performance, ability to survive and other characteristics associated with fitness as a result of inbreeding.
______ are the sites of active RNA synthesis. 2.
Puffs
Puffs are the sites of active RNA synthesis. 2.
______ is the vegetative offspring of one specific mother plant; it does not show any genetic, morphologic or physiologic deviations from the mother plant.
clone
A clone is the vegetative offspring of one specific mother plant; it does not show any genetic, morphologic or physiologic deviations from the mother plant.
______ is an important tool in predicting the effects of inbreeding and assessing the risk of inheritable genetic defects.
Inbreeding study
Inbreeding study is an important tool in predicting the effects of inbreeding and assessing the risk of inheritable genetic defects.
______ is the failure of plants to produce functional anthers, pollen, or male gametes.
Male sterility
Male sterility is the failure of plants to produce functional anthers, pollen, or male gametes.
